newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * NATO foreign ministers agreed to welcome three new members -- Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic -- but said the alliance will keep an open door to countries like Romania and Slovenia.
* Romania was mentioned several times during the Tuesday session of NATO's summit in Madrid, the national radio said.
It said several NATO members pleaded that Romania had a strategic position for the alliance and was a security supplier. They praised the Balkan country for its democratic progress.
* The members of the alliance agreed on a text that would express NATO's committment for further enlargenment in years to come.
* Seven NATO members supported Romania and Slovenia for a quick NATO admission.
* Romania needs to completely change its foreign policy after NATO's Madrid summit, said Adrian Nastase, executive leader of the main opposition Party of Social Democracy.
Nastase said the the western alliance's decision to invite only three new members forced Romania to start all over again, from scratch its efforts for getting NATO membership.
